task.title: Resolve workflow-phase skills explicitly
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/740 with a read-only bridge from one caller-chosen phase to the existing caller-owned skill registry.
acceptance_criteria: Return only exact phase-bound registered skills in deterministic exact-ID order.
Fail closed on malformed, duplicate, or missing bindings without partial selection.
Resolve empty bindings successfully without selecting unrelated skills.
Use the same operation for cursor and replayed durable-run phases.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused suite failed because RegisteredWorkflowPhase::resolve_skills did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added cursor, replayed-run, missing-registration, empty-binding, terminal-binding, and malformed-topology tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Converting exact bindings to SkillId and calling SkillRegistry::select preserved all-or-nothing errors and deterministic ordering without a second registry.
attempts.patch: Added resolve_skills and ADR-0019 while keeping duplicate-selection and empty-selection behavior delegated to the existing registry boundary.

outcome.summary: A caller can explicitly resolve one borrowed phase to registered skills, while provider invocation, prompt mutation, tools, workflow movement, and lifecycle authorization remain out of scope.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_phase_skill_resolution

lessons: Reuse caller-owned registries and typed selection errors instead of creating workflow-specific authority.
Deterministic exact-ID output order is independent of authored binding order.
Resolution is read-only selection and does not itself compose a prompt or execute a phase.
